notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
YES!! After 2 weeks of waiting, ZENKAT has finally been released!!

Dev note:

This is my first game I created independently with nothing but a lot of coffee and my cat, Tupac, on my lap.

Thank you to my friends, family and all those who support me in the smallest way possible, albeit a small start, it is a major step in what I would like to achieve one day.
